subject: Non-Normal Multivariate Test and MLM Estimator

messages.author: b48ebf16ed4cffef
messages.subject: Non-Normal Multivariate Test and MLM Estimator
parts:
Before fitting my SEM model, with "MLM" estimator in Lavaan, I get the following results from the Mardia's multivariate normality test in MVN package:

Mardias' Multivariate Normality Test
                              Test        Statistic            p-value
Mardia Skewness           75.5                   0.0001
Mardia Kurtosis               3.49                  0.0004

All variables were log-transformed to avoid an ill-scaled covariance matrix, as suggested by Kline (2015) in his book.  Is this process a kind of rescaling a variable? Specifically, I did it because of the following warning message:

1: In lav_data_full(data = data, group = group, cluster = cluster,  :
  lavaan WARNING: some observed variances are (at least) a factor 1000 times larger than others; use varTable(fit) to investigate

Is it right? Also, is there any problem if I continue to run the SEM model with maximum likelihood estimation with robust standard errors and a Satorra-Bentler Chi-square scaled test statistic? Is there any other better alternative?

Thanks.
